name: Meta Cheyenne data center
summary: Meta data center campus of 715,000 square feet in Cheyenne, Wyoming, announced in July 2024 as an investment of more than USD 800 million and described as optimized for Meta's AI workloads. Meta's fact sheet and location list now put the investment at USD 1.2 billion, and the list gives 2024 as the groundbreaking year. Black Hills Energy is Meta's energy partner, and Meta refers readers to Fortis Construction for construction information. Meta reports one Wyoming project adding 365 MW of clean energy and 200 MW of battery storage to the grid. No power capacity or opening date for the data center has been published.

location.note: City point from OpenStreetMap Nominatim; Meta names Cheyenne but gives no site or road.

notes: The status rests on two undated Meta pages: the U.S. location list, which gives 2024 as the groundbreaking year, and the fact sheet, which describes the data center in the future tense. status_as_of is therefore the date both were read (2026-10-09). The fact sheet PDF shows no publication date; its embedded file creation date is 2026-09-01.
